name: monorepo
description: Masjid Dashboard - Monorepo with independent apps

scripts.setup: npm install && cd apps/web && npm install && cd ../api && npm install && cd ../pocketbase && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --raw "npm run dev --prefix apps/web" "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/pocketbase"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --raw "npm run start --prefix apps/web" "npm run start --prefix apps/api" "npm run start --prefix apps/pocketbase"
scripts.lint: concurrently --raw "cd apps/web && npm run lint" "cd apps/api && npm run lint"
scripts.clean: cd apps/web && npm run clean && cd ../api && npm run clean && cd ../pocketbase && npm run clean
